dedupe_keys.name: eett antenna constructions information portal licensed and declared antenna structures by municipality greece

description: The antenna constructions information portal of the Hellenic Telecommunications and Post Commission lets the public look up antenna structures in the commission's register. For each structure a user can see whether it holds an EETT construction licence or has been declared to EETT, the content of the licence or declaration with the approvals of other competent bodies, the legal framework under which it was licensed, and the company that owns it. Searches run by municipality or address, by area on a map, or by recent licensing period and regional unit. The portal also explains which antenna categories need a licence and which only a declaration, and which bodies license and inspect them, and links to the Greek Atomic Energy Commission's electromagnetic field measurements. Coverage: Greece. Format and access: web search and map, free; no bulk download was found. Caveats: structures exempt from licensing or declaration are not in the register; inspection results and pending applications are not shown; operators and technologies must be read record by record, so assembling a national layer means scraping. Simulation uses: locating mobile and broadcast antenna structures for hazard exposure in earthquake, wildfire and flood scenarios. Related records: the Dutch Antenneregister, the Finnsenderen Norway mobile transmitters and the Flanders transmitting antennas map are comparable registers with downloads.
